testcase.name: pushing up during a refresh closes the gap before the list scrolls
a pull while a refresh runs does not start another, and one after it ends does
pulling and settling recompose none of the content
a flick up during a refresh closes the gap and carries the list on without a pause
a fling that reaches the top never refreshes
the content rests below the spinner while refreshing, and returns when it ends
the release carries the finger's velocity into the settle
a pull released short of the trigger springs back without refreshing
the refresh starts as the pull crosses the trigger, before the finger lifts
